description: The plot illustrates the similarity of HSAs in different languages across all layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot contains four solid lines without markers, representing different language pairs: 'en&en' (red), 'en&es' (blue), 'en&el' (green), and 'en&bn' (pink). The red line begins at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, rises to a sharp peak of roughly 0.26 at layer 6, experiences a secondary, broader peak around 0.18 between layers 11 and 12, declines to a low of about 0.08 at layer 20, and then sharply increases to end at approximately 0.43 at layer 23. The blue line starts at roughly 0.06 at layer 0, peaks at approximately 0.24 at layer 6, has a secondary peak near 0.17 at layer 12, declines to about 0.06 at layer 20, and sharply rises to end at approximately 0.27 at layer 23. The green line begins at approximately 0.04 at layer 0, reaches a peak of about 0.15 at layer 6, shows a secondary peak near 0.15 at layer 12, decreases to roughly 0.05 between layers 18 and 21, and sharply increases to end at approximately 0.30 at layer 23. Finally, the pink line starts at roughly 0.03 at layer 0, peaks at approximately 0.14 at layer 6, has a secondary peak near 0.14 at layer 12, declines to about 0.05 between layers 18 and 21, and sharply rises to end at approximately 0.29 at layer 23.
caption_used: The similarity of HSAs in different languages across all layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B is depicted. The line plot shows four language pairs: 'en&en' (red), 'en&es' (blue), 'en&el' (green), and 'en&bn' (pink). The horizontal axis represents the layers, ranging from 0 to 24, while the vertical axis indicates similarity, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45. The red line starts at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, peaks at layer 6 with a value of 0.26, and then declines steadily to 0.08 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.43 at layer 23. The blue line begins at 0.06 at layer 0, peaks at layer 6 with a value of 0.24, and then stabilizes around 0.06 from layer 20 onward, showing no significant increase. The green and pink lines exhibit similar trends, starting at 0.04 and 0.03 respectively, peaking at layer 6 with values of 0.15 and 0.13, and then declining to 0.05 at layer 20 before increasing to 0.3 at layer 23. Notably, the similarity between 'en&es' consistently exceeds that of 'en&en' across layers 6 to 20, contrary to expectations.
